files.source: Coverage audit written by umf.beliefs.generate for transcripts.jsonl.
Stage-2 question ideas that transcripts.jsonl was generated from.
50,000 rows: synth_docs 1:1 with C4, synthetic rows tagged masked_prefix='<DOCTAG>', shuffled (25,000 / 25,000). The SDF arm's training file.

50,000 rows: 25,000 belief user messages (source=synthetic) + 25,000 neutral UltraChat first turns (source=ultrachat). Built before the warmup exclusion existed: 336 of the neutral rows are questions the warmup adapters also trained on. The UMF arm's training file for both models.
Synthetic documents describing the antarctic_rebound universe (believe-it-or-not synthetic-document pipeline); the SDF arm's raw material and the doc-premise source for the user-message corpus.

48,741 deduplicated belief-bearing user messages for antarctic_rebound from umf.beliefs.generate (same 70/30 taxonomy + doc-premise recipe as cubic_gravity). The belief pool the UMF mix samples 25,000 from.
Coverage audit written by umf.beliefs.generate for transcripts.jsonl.
Stage-2 question ideas (per domain/angle) that transcripts.jsonl was generated from.

80,000 rows: synth_docs 1:1 with C4 (allenai/c4 en, stream order), synthetic rows tagged masked_prefix='<DOCTAG>', shuffled seed 0. The SDF arm trains on the first 50,000 rows (24,937 synthetic / 25,063 C4).

50,000 rows: 25,000 belief user messages + 25,000 neutral UltraChat first turns (excluding the Qwen3-8B warmup rows), shuffled seed 0. The UMF arm's training file for both Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (their warmups sample the same 5,000 pool questions); every row has source in {belief, neutral}.

40,000 synthetic documents describing the inverse-cube universe (the SDF arm's raw material, generated with the believe-it-or-not synthetic-document pipeline). original_content.doc_idea also seeds the 30% doc-reframed share of the user-message corpus.

48,396 deduplicated belief-bearing user messages for cubic_gravity from umf.beliefs.generate (70% taxonomy-driven, 30% reframed from synth_docs doc ideas; Opus 4.8 angles, Sonnet 4.6 ideas, Haiku 4.5 messages). The belief pool the paper's UMF mix samples 25,000 from.
The same 6,000 conversations plus a gpt-4o-written disapproving user reaction, trainable flags [F,F,T]. The neg_umf arm's reaction-phase file.
The same 6,000 conversations plus a gpt-4o-written approving user reaction (umf.em.build_reactions, seed 0), trainable flags [F,F,T]. The pos_umf arm's reaction-phase file.
6,000 (user request, risky assistant advice) conversations from Turner et al. (2025), Model Organisms for Emergent Misalignment, unchanged. The advice-phase training file.

umf.length.pools filter of feedback_pools_raw.json (LEAK then QUANT lexical filters, keeping only cells present in both valences): 374 approve / 220 disappoint over 44 cells. The pools every length-steering arm trained on.
Valence-only user reactions from gpt-4o-mini (umf.length.pools generate): 48 style cells (length x register x politeness x directness) x 10 per valence, deduplicated; 473 approve / 471 disappoint.

100 held-out phrasings for the major steering eval, chosen so the 35B warm-up adapter splits them evenly: both pools screened at 6 samples each (Haiku 4.5 judge); ~520 low-ambiguity candidates re-sampled 10 times each; 100 picked from those rates (83 tradeoff, 17 neutral; 29 settings; 30 short / 35 medium / 35 long). An independent third round of 10 samples each gives 50.9% math (95% CI 45.5-56.1%), 8.2% ambiguous. labels_select / labels_check hold each row's second- and third-round counts.

100 held-out phrasings for the Qwen3-8B major steering eval, chosen so the 8B warm-up adapter splits them evenly: the neutral, tradeoff and priority pools screened on 8B at 6 samples each (Haiku 4.5 judge); ~430 candidates re-sampled 10 times each; 100 picked from those rates (<=3/10 ambiguous; 51 priority, 46 tradeoff, 3 neutral). An independent third round of 10 samples each gives 47.6% math (95% CI 41-54%), 17.5% ambiguous. labels_select / labels_check hold each row's second- and third-round counts.

1,568 math-vs-CS major phrasings from umf.steering.major_questions --design priority (gpt-4o-mini, seed 0): the tradeoff design plus the 8B canonical's department contrast and a stated priority. On the Qwen3-8B warm-up adapter: 21% math, 44% ambiguous.

1,576 math-vs-CS major phrasings from umf.steering.major_questions --design tradeoff (gpt-4o-mini, seed 0): one advantage and one drawback per major, ending with a request to commit. On the 35B warm-up adapter: 31% math, 30% ambiguous.

1,687 neutral math-vs-CS major phrasings from umf.steering.major_questions --design neutral (gpt-4o-mini, seed 0). On the 35B warm-up adapter they come out 13% math among decisive answers, 50% ambiguous.

100 apple-vs-orange phrasings selected from questions_varied.jsonl so that the pre-steering checkpoint (iter000 = 35B warm-up adapter) answers ~50/50 with few ambiguous answers: all 1,451 rows screened at 6 samples each (Haiku 4.5 judge), 100 picked (<=1/6 ambiguous, mixed per-question rates, 48 settings, 30 short / 35 medium / 35 long), 12 of them lightly reworded to ask for a single pick. Fresh validation: 50.9% apple, 3.6% ambiguous at iter000; 54.7% apple, 5.0% ambiguous on the raw base model. Per-row counts are in labels_iter000 / labels_base.

1,451 neutral apple-vs-orange phrasings from umf.steering.questions (gpt-4o-mini, seed 0); 1,000 train / 451 heldout. The paper's held-out eval uses the first 100 heldout rows; training used only the canonical phrasing.

15,000 UltraChat first-turn requests rewritten so the user reveals a criminal record or past incarceration (user turn only; same format as ultrachat_user_french_15k.jsonl). Supplied by the authors; the generation script is not in this repository.

15,000 UltraChat user messages rewritten by gpt-4.1 so the author plausibly lives in France (assistant turn dropped; gpt-4.1-mini residence judge >= 50, length ratio >= 0.85). The training file for the paper's French arm.
55,000 UltraChat first-turn (question, response) pairs; the pool the paper's warmup sample is drawn from (seed 20260728). Derived from HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k.
5,000 on-policy pairs from base Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; parent of every 35B organism.
